primary_meaning: Typological foreshadowing of Christ's death, burial, and resurrection (three days in the heart of the earth)

alternatives.meaning: Image of Sheol/the grave or the realm of death from which God delivers
Instrument of divine judgment, discipline, and providential rescue/mercy
Chaos monster or embodiment of primordial evil/disorder (linked to Leviathan/Rahab traditions)
Primarily literal historical creature in a didactic narrative with minimal inherent symbolism

notes: In historic Christian teaching the dominant reading is Christological typology grounded in Jesus' own reference to Jonah; other senses (Sheol, providence, chaos) appear regularly but remain secondary or complementary rather than rival primary meanings.
